common: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone BREED dog collectible plush toy. Reference image is style only: match its handmade velour/felt, fine soft plush fibers, tiny glossy bead eyes, small embroidered smiling mouth, rounded stuffed-toy proportions, gentle warm lighting. Breed features: FEATURES. Seated full body, slight three-quarter front view, paws level. True transparent RGBA background, centered single toy with clear margins around entire ears paws and tail. No floor, pedestal, accessories, text, labels, watermark or other animals. A stuffed toy, not a living dog. Breed distinguishable at 80px shelf size. Natural uncropped ears and undocked tail unless the breed is naturally short-tailed.
